premises.text: Mobile users share pain: weak signal where it matters, poor call quality, and service costs too much
premises.evidence_span: I can never get a signal in places that are really important, like my house or my office

premises.text: TextFree delivers free unlimited texting and real mobile numbers, including to non-phone devices
premises.evidence_span: TextFree lets you send free, unlimited text messages

premises.text: Text-free with voice is a SIP VoIP client turning iPod Touch/iPad into a free calling phone
premises.evidence_span: Text-free with voice is a full-on SIP-based voice over IP client

premises.text: Young users (12–26) earn free minutes via app downloads/offers instead of paying
premises.evidence_span: you could go to our offer window, and you choose an application. And you could download it

premises.text: Wi-Fi/3G big pipe enables HD-quality audio and solves home/office reception gaps
premises.evidence_span: over Wi-Fi, because it's a big, big pipe, we can use a nice codec to give you HD quality audio

premises.text: In-text ad impressions monetize the wait-for-reply moment with brands targeting first-time buyers
premises.evidence_span: five seconds after you hit the send button, you're sitting there looking at your screen waiting for a reply, it's a perfect time for an ad

premises.text: Platform expands via OS+data connection to other platforms, in-flight Wi-Fi, and Facebook
premises.evidence_span: all we need is an operating system and a data connection, and we could take it to other platforms easily

domains.name: mobile signal quality and cost pain

value.text: Free high-quality texting and talking for mobile users who hate cost and bad reception
value.evidence_span: we want to make texting, and now today, talking, free
